item.title: [AI & I by Every] Claude Code Can Be Your Second Brain
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:28 Noah Breyer might have the coolest Claude code setup I've ever seen. He rigged a home server in his basement, put his Obsidian vault in it, and then runs Claude code on top. So he can think, research, write, and even ship code right from his phone. Today, he shows us how he uses Claude Code as a true second brain, a thinking partner that asks him sharp questions, pulls research from his whole note archive and the web, and even keeps a running log of what he's learned an...
